Well, there's basically two flavors of trolling. There's High Value Trolling, and there's Low Value Trolling.

Both are done for roughly the same reason; that is, to get a predictable reaction that can be built upon, so that the troll can continue to "feed".

High Value Trolls, referred to as HVTs, are really the gems of the internet age. Using a mixture of wit, sarcasm, and general asshole behavior, HVTs can produce some of the funniest shit we've seen on the web to date. They're generally applauded by everyone but their targets, they put effort and thought into what they do, and can even use their trolling to bring to light the more unsavory or downright flawed aspects of whatever it is they're targeting.

Then you have the Low Value Trolls, or LVTs. These individuals put no effort into what they do. LVTs target the weakest members of the human herd by spouting off anything they think might produce a knee jerk response. Unlike HVTs, LVTs are easy to spot and avoid with a bit of self awareness and general knowledge of how the internet community works. They are rarely funny to anyone but themselves and maybe a small circle of compatriots, who will often sit in the background and masturbate excessively to the work of other LVTs. They think they're doing it for the lols, but like so many failed stand up comedians, the only laughter they are receiving is directed solely at their pathetic efforts to run with the big dogs.
